findings.title: Swapped lightness percentages in `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a`
findings.body: `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` originally used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The `30%` and `70%` lightness values are inverted, making the author link much fainter than intended in both light and dark themes. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Swapped lightness percentages in `.custom-message-length`
findings.body: `.custom-message-length` originally used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, but was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The `70%` and `30%` values are inverted (compare with `desktop/modal.scss` line 94 where the same rule uses `70%` for `$primary` and `30%` for `$secondary`).

findings.title: Wrong lightness values for `.topic-map h3` on mobile
findings.body: `.topic-map h3` originally used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`, but was changed to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`, alterings its light-theme color and making it identical to `.topic-map h4` below it. To match the original value and `desktop/topic-post.scss` line 321, it should use `20%` for `$primary` and `80%` for `$secondary`.

findings.title: Unintended lightness change for `.group-member-info .name`
findings.body: `.group-member-info .name` (here and in `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss` line 497) originally used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, distinct from `.group-member-info .title` at `50%`. Replacing it with `50%` / `50%` instead of `30%` / `70%` changes the light-theme color and removes the visual distinction between `.name` and `.title`.
